scope: Phase 3 verification only. Original RAR archives were not modified; extraction was performed under data/raw/Paderborn/extracted/. No model training, split creation, full-dataset preprocessing, or config modification occurred.

recording_summary.measurement_numbers: Each condition contains the complete sequence 1..20 for every bearing.

matlab_structure.top_level: One MATLAB struct named exactly as the MAT filename stem.

sampling_rates.documentation: The local measuring logs and official documentation specify 64 kHz for vibration/current, 4 kHz for mechanical signals, and 1 Hz for temperature.
sampling_rates.interpretation: 64 kHz is the documented nominal rate. Stored HostService time axes/sample counts are not uniformly 64,000 samples per declared second; future implementation must inspect/use the time axis and define its crop/resampling policy explicitly.

duration.documentation: 20 measurements of four seconds per operating setting.
duration.note: Variable array lengths are a real property of the extracted recordings, not a reason to infer a fixed 256001-sample shape.

integrity_issues.issue: Stored HostService sample counts vary despite nominal 64 kHz and approximately four-second recordings.
integrity_issues.action_before_training: Define and document an explicit time-axis-aware fixed-length crop/pad or resampling policy using training data only.

integrity_issues.issue: Two KI16 records report durations greater than four seconds.
integrity_issues.action_before_training: Choose a deterministic policy before data implementation; do not silently assume four seconds.

traceability.bearing_id: Independent experimental unit; taken from RAR name, extraction directory, and filename bearing token.
traceability.mat_recording: One measurement, identified by full relative MAT path and filename fields (condition, bearing ID, measurement number).
traceability.future_window: Derived sample only; must retain source archive, bearing ID, MAT relative path, operating condition, measurement number, and sample/time offsets. A window is never an independent bearing.

track1_compatibility.reason: Every loaded MAT file provides a one-dimensional vibration_1 time series with documented nominal 64 kHz acquisition and traceable bearing/condition/measurement identity.

requirements: Approve a fixed-length/time-axis policy for variable HostService lengths and KI16 duration outliers.
Preserve bearing-disjoint grouping; do not make random window splits.
Obtain/declare organizer fixed-split and metric requirements before implementation.
